name: TabTender – Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce
author: linktender

sections.description:
TabTender adds custom product tabs to WooCommerce product pages. Add shipping details, size guides, care instructions or videos to any product, reuse the same tab on many products, and tidy up the built-in tabs.

Custom tabs on every product

  • A “Tabs” panel in Product data for every product type.
  • Each tab has a title, rich content (editor with media, shortcodes and embeds) and a priority.
  • Drag to reorder, or use the up and down buttons. Hide a tab without deleting it.
  • Stable tab links such as #tab-shipping that keep working after edits.

Saved tabs library

  • Write a tab once in Products → Saved Tabs and add it to any product.
  • Edit it once and every product that uses it updates on the next page load.
  • Detach a saved tab to make an editable copy for one product.
  • Ships a wpml-config.xml for WPML and Polylang, so tab titles, tab content and saved tabs can be translated.

Built-in tabs

  • Rename, reorder or hide Description, Additional information and Reviews for the whole shop, or for one product.
  • The Reviews title can show the review count with %d.

Move from YIKES Custom Product Tabs in one click

  • TabTender detects tabs from YIKES Custom Product Tabs and shows them exactly as before, even after YIKES is deactivated.
  • One-click import of product tabs and saved tabs, in the background, with progress, a dry run, a log and undo.
  • The import never changes or deletes YIKES data, and running it twice does not create duplicates.
  • Also available from WP-CLI: wp tabtender import yikes.

Built for shops

  • WooCommerce CSV export and import (column “TabTender tabs”) and WP All Import support.
  • Works with classic and block themes, HPOS and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • No ads, no tracking, no external requests.

Everything described above is free, with no locked features and no account.

External services

TabTender does not connect to any external service and sends no data anywhere.

If you paste a video or other media link on its own line in a tab, WordPress itself fetches the embed from that provider (for example YouTube), exactly as it does for links in posts. TabTender adds no requests of its own.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.6 or later.
  2. In Plugins → Add New, search for “TabTender”, then install and activate it.
  3. Edit a product and open Product data → Tabs to add tabs.
  4. Shop-wide settings are in Products → TabTender. Reusable tabs are in Products → Saved Tabs.
sections.faq:
How do I move from YIKES Custom Product Tabs?

Keep YIKES installed. Activate TabTender, go to Products → TabTender → Import, preview with the dry run, then click “Import YIKES tabs”. When the import is done, check a few products and deactivate YIKES. Do not delete YIKES before the import is finished: deleting YIKES erases its tab data. Deactivating it is safe, and TabTender keeps showing tabs that are not imported yet exactly as YIKES did.

What happens to my tabs if I deactivate or delete TabTender?

Deactivating keeps all tabs; they show again when you reactivate. Deleting TabTender removes its settings but keeps your tabs and saved tabs, unless you turned on “Delete all TabTender tabs, saved tabs and settings when the plugin is deleted” in Products → TabTender. YIKES data is never touched.

Does it work with block themes?

Yes. With a block theme, WooCommerce shows product details as tabs or as an accordion, and custom tabs appear in both. If your Single Product template uses the accordion, rename or hide its built-in items in Appearance → Editor → Single Product.

Can I undo the YIKES import?

Yes. Products → TabTender → Import → Undo removes imported tabs from products you have not edited since, and moves unused imported saved tabs to the trash.

How do I import tabs with a CSV file?

Export products in Products → Export to see the “TabTender tabs” column (JSON). For hand-made files you can also use the columns “TabTender tab 1 title”, “TabTender tab 1 content” and “TabTender tab 1 priority”, up to tab 10. An empty cell leaves a product’s tabs unchanged. Older files with a “Meta: yikes_woo_products_tabs” column from YIKES Custom Product Tabs also work: TabTender turns that column into tabs, whether or not YIKES is active.

How do I use WP All Import?

Add a custom field named tabtender_tabs_json with the same JSON as the “TabTender tabs” CSV column. TabTender turns it into tabs after each product is saved. For WP All Export, use the PHP function tabtender_get_tabs_json( $product_id ).

Why does a tab not show?

Tabs need a title. Tabs with empty content are hidden unless you turn off “Hide tabs whose content is empty”. Saved tabs show only while published.

Some plugin adds share buttons to my tabs.

Switch Products → TabTender → Settings → Tab content formatting to “Safe”. It formats text and runs shortcodes without the full the_content filter.

Is there a Pro version?

Not yet. A separate paid add-on is planned (tabs on many products by category, tag or brand, bulk tools, FAQ and spec templates, tab content in store search). The free plugin is complete on its own, and nothing in it is locked.
